title: Proton Pass vs 1Password for password management
meta_description: Proton Pass vs 1Password for people and teams evaluating a password manager migration: documented workflows, constraints, and a source-backed decision summary.
intro: This source-backed comparison addresses the observed query pattern “Proton Pass vs 1Password” for people and teams evaluating a password manager migration. It compares stable, documented workflows and constraints rather than volatile prices, inventory, ratings, or reviews.
verdict: Choose Proton Pass when its account ecosystem and supported credential workflow are the closer fit. Choose 1Password when structured vault and access-management workflows match the requirement. Test recovery, sharing, device support, and organization controls before moving live credentials.
